avatar.resetDesc: Clear custom avatar and fall back to the deterministic pixel Identicon.
avatar.nftNote: Only NFTs from admin-approved contracts are accepted.

insufficient_balance.title: Insufficient Balance
insufficient_balance.description: Your wallet does not have enough XLM to cover the buy-in and network fee reserve.
insufficient_balance.cause: Account balance is below the required amount plus the Stellar base reserve.
insufficient_balance.action: Deposit additional XLM into your wallet to cover the table buy-in and minimum balance requirements.

timeout.title: Transaction Timeout
timeout.description: The transaction or RPC request timed out before receiving network confirmation.
timeout.cause: Network congestion or temporary RPC node latency caused the request to exceed its timeout window.
timeout.action: Check your network connection and retry the transaction. Your funds have not been deducted.

seq.title: Sequence Number Mismatch
seq.description: The transaction sequence number does not match the current account sequence on-chain.
seq.cause: Another transaction was submitted from this account concurrently, advancing the sequence.
seq.action: Refresh the table to fetch the updated account sequence number and retry.

expired.title: Transaction Expired
expired.description: The transaction reached its maximum time bounds or ledger sequence bounds before inclusion.
expired.cause: The transaction remained pending past the ledger sequence expiry limit.
expired.action: Submit a fresh transaction with current ledger time bounds.

budget.title: Resource Budget Exceeded
budget.description: The contract invocation exceeded the Soroban CPU or memory instruction budget.
budget.cause: Complex smart contract execution consumed more compute units or storage instructions than budgeted.
budget.action: Review operation parameters or wait for fee/budget adjustments before retrying.

unknown.title: Transaction Error
unknown.cause: Unknown error or contract panic occurred during execution.
unknown.action: Check the technical simulation logs below or retry the operation.

offline.viewingCached: You are viewing cached table data while disconnected.
